$comment: Cannons and cannonballs (docs/CANNONS.md; owner, 2026-11-17, 2026-11-18). `cannons`: each a block (shared/blocks) whose Use fires it (block data `use: fire`): `ball` the ball it fires (a `balls` name), `muzzleSpeedMs` the ball's speed out of the barrel along the cannon's facing, `muzzleUpM` and `muzzleForwardM` where it leaves (m from the cannon's rear bottom cell's centre: up, and forward along the facing), `reloadS` the least time between shots (0: none; owner, 2026-11-18: "set that to off or none, so you can fire quickly"). `balls`: each a block of look `ball` by `name`, `radiusM`, `densityKgM3` (steel 7,850: "a heavy steel ball"; owner 2026-11-18: "double the size", "8× mass, real steel"), `rollDamping` (its rolling resistance: its speed's damping, 1/s, while it touches the ground), and its `impact` (owner, 2026-11-18, one design replacing the knock and explosive balls): each breakable block its sphere runs into is destroyed while it moves at `destroySpeedMs` or more, the ball losing `energyPerKgJ` joules for each kg of the block ("by the block's weight"); slower than that the block is knocked loose as a physics block and the contact slows it. At each such hit the breakable cells within `dragRadiusM` of its centre come loose too (at most `maxLooseCells` a tick), and every loose piece within `dragRadiusM` of it is pushed along its velocity by `dragForcePerSpeedN` newtons for each m/s of its speed, every tick ("it should exert continuous force as it flies around it, in its velocity direction"); slower than `minSpeedMs` it does none of this. Prototype values.
